title.zh: 79AU运营热钱包攻击者已返还15000枚BNB，价值约1100万美元
title.en: 79AU运营热钱包攻击者已返还15000枚BNB，价值约1100万美元

current_state.zh: The attacker behind the ~$12.5M 79thVault hot-wallet exploit on BNB Chain returned 15,000 BNB (about $11M) to a wallet address designated by the 79AU team, after previously depositing 30 BNB to KuCoin, with the disposition of remaining funds still unclear.
current_state.en: The attacker behind the ~$12.5M 79thVault hot-wallet exploit on BNB Chain returned 15,000 BNB (about $11M) to a wallet address designated by the 79AU team, after previously depositing 30 BNB to KuCoin, with the disposition of remaining funds still unclear.
